situation: a running card blocked with kind needs_input
expect: cap_cards.waiting_on = owner, waiting_words = needs your answer, phase = waiting

situation: a heartbeat task_event since the watermark
expect: no event line; the run's snap line carries last_heartbeat_at

situation: an old-system-era task_runs row: runner NULL and run_id NULL
expect: cap_runs snap row era = the stored legacy era value, run_id = the stored legacy run-id prefix + <task_runs.id>, never skipped

situation: a card blocked needs_input, then unblocked (tasks.block_kind stays needs_input)
expect: next pass: cap_blocks closed_by unblocked, cap_cards.waiting_on not owner

situation: a done card with an open first_screen_hold
expect: cap_cards phase waiting, waiting_on owner, waiting_words screen to approve, block_kind first_screen_hold

situation: a card parked in triage at the failure limit (block_kind NULL)
expect: cap_cards waiting_on owner, waiting_words failed too often, reset it, block_kind parked

situation: a card human-parked (parked event, by human, no other open block)
expect: cap_cards waiting_on owner, waiting_words you parked it: <trigger>, block_kind parked, block_reason the trigger

situation: a card with an open needs_input block, then human-parked (parked event, by human)
expect: the needs_input cap_blocks row closes closed_by reset (park-over-hold, not an owner reset); a new parked block opens; cap_cards waiting_on owner, waiting_words you parked it: <trigger>

situation: the unshipped spool is above SPOOL_MAX_BYTES
expect: compaction keeps every event line and only the newest snap line per key; offset reset to 0

situation: maintain_spool crashes right after os.replace installs the rotated/compacted file
expect: the offset is already 0 before the rename runs, so a crash there leaves offset 0 against whichever file (old or new) is on disk - never misaligned with the file that replaced it

situation: maintain_spool crashes before os.replace ever runs (offset already reset to 0)
expect: the spool on disk is still the old, unrotated file, untouched; offset 0 against it is a safe, idempotent re-ship from byte 0, never a mismatch

situation: a held implementer run (never outcome=completed) that a human accept sent to review, a request_review event naming it
expect: cap_cards.review_rounds = 1, read from review_scope.reviewer_round, never a bare outcome='completed' count

situation: a card blocked with kind transient (lander wait or epic-sync fetch failure), with and without a board/account pause in guard_state
expect: cap_cards waiting_on owner, phase waiting, waiting_words blocked, no retry scheduled: unblock|reset; never retrying automatically
